QT Clustering Benchmark - Simplified Sequential Version\n// \n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    \n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Find closest point to current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points, \n                                             threshold, point_count);\n        \n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n        \n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    \n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    \n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    \n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    \n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        \n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n            \n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points, \n                                                       threshold, N, \n                                                       &candidate_members);\n            \n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            \n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            \n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n    \n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        \n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]], \n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", \n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n        \n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", \n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n    \n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\", \n               num_points, threshold);\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n    printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Generate synthetic data\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n    \n    // Perform QT clustering\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold);\n    \n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1jkC8er2iksKVZCGgvs","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The baseline runs and validates. `output.txt` is an old session transcript, so I'll leave it alone.\n\nMy plan:\n- **MPI, unconditional:** each round, seed candidates are split cyclically across ranks. The best candidate is picked with `MPI_Allreduce(MPI_MAXLOC)` over (cardinality, seed). MAXLOC returns the lowest seed on ties, which matches the serial first-wins scan. Every rank keeps identical clustering state, so the data is generated locally and only one 8-byte reduction runs per cluster.\n- **Same output, faster candidate growth:** `generateCandidateCluster` keeps a running max-distance per candidate, instead of recomputing it against all members each step. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1jkC8er2iksKVZCGgvs","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01TkxgbCnm4o11AkD1YDrrhV","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261012-111947/qtclustering_claude-haiku-5.5-cc-medium_mpi_r5/qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","content":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - MPI Distributed Version\n//\n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// Parallelization: every rank holds the same point set and the same clustering\n// state. Each round, the seed candidates are split across ranks, each rank finds\n// its best local seed, and an MPI_MAXLOC reduction selects the global best\n// (largest cardinality, lowest seed index on ties, matching the serial order).\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Unclustered point considered for the cluster being grown, together with its\n// maximum distance to the cluster members added so far\nstruct Candidate {\n    int index;\n    double max_dist;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    // Unclustered points in index order. A candidate's max_dist is the maximum\n    // distance to all current members; it only grows as members are added, so a\n    // candidate that reaches the threshold can never join and is dropped.\n    std::vector<Candidate> candidates;\n    candidates.reserve(point_count);\n    for (int c = 0; c < point_count; ++c) {\n        if (!clustered[c] && c != seed_point) {\n            candidates.push_back({c, 0.0});\n        }\n    }\n\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    int newest = seed_point;\n\n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Fold the newest member into every candidate's max distance\n        size_t kept = 0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < candidates.size(); ++i) {\n            Candidate cand = candidates[i];\n            cand.max_dist = std::max(cand.max_dist, distance(points[cand.index], points[newest]));\n            if (cand.max_dist < threshold) {\n                candidates[kept++] = cand;\n            }\n        }\n        candidates.resize(kept);\n\n        if (candidates.empty()) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        // Closest candidate; candidates stay in index order, so ties go to the lowest index\n        size_t best = 0;\n        for (size_t i = 1; i < candidates.size(); ++i) {\n            if (candidates[i].max_dist < candidates[best].max_dist) {\n                best = i;\n            }\n        }\n\n        newest = candidates[best].index;\n        candidates.erase(candidates.begin() + best);\n        members.push_back(newest);\n    }\n\n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n\n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm. All ranks run this collectively and end with\n// identical cluster lists.\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  const int rank,\n                                  const int num_ranks) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        // Try this rank's share of the unclustered points as seeds (cyclic split of the\n        // list keeps the work balanced as points get removed)\n        int local_cardinality = -1;\n        int local_seed = N;\n        for (size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(rank); }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// Benchmark driver. Each round, the seed candidates are split across ranks, each rank finds\n// its best local seed, and an MPI_MAXLOC reduction selects the global best\n// (largest cardinality, lowest seed index on ties, matching the serial order).\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Unclustered point considered for the cluster being grown, together with its\n// maximum distance to the cluster members added so far\nstruct Candidate {\n    int index;\n    double max_dist;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    // Unclustered points in index order. A candidate's max_dist is the maximum\n    // distance to all current members; it only grows as members are added, so a\n    // candidate that reaches the threshold can never join and is dropped.\n    std::vector<Candidate> candidates;\n    candidates.reserve(point_count);\n    for (int c = 0; c < point_count; ++c) {\n        if (!clustered[c] && c != seed_point) {\n            candidates.push_back({c, 0.0});\n        }\n    }\n\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    int newest = seed_point;\n\n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Fold the newest member into every candidate's max distance\n        size_t kept = 0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < candidates.size(); ++i) {\n            Candidate cand = candidates[i];\n            cand.max_dist = std::max(cand.max_dist, distance(points[cand.index], points[newest]));\n            if (cand.max_dist < threshold) {\n                candidates[kept++] = cand;\n            }\n        }\n        candidates.resize(kept);\n\n        if (candidates.empty()) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        // Closest candidate; candidates stay in index order, so ties go to the lowest index\n        size_t best = 0;\n        for (size_t i = 1; i < candidates.size(); ++i) {\n            if (candidates[i].max_dist < candidates[best].max_dist) {\n                best = i;\n            }\n        }\n\n        newest = candidates[best].index;\n        candidates.erase(candidates.begin() + best);\n        members.push_back(newest);\n    }\n\n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n\n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm. Its output matches the original exactly, and it is much faster. I changed only `qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp` and `qtclustering/CMakeLists.txt`. The executable is still `qtclustering`, and no files were added.\n\n**Results**\n- **Correctness:** I compared the new binary against the original for six input sets (N = 60 to 2000, several thresholds) at 1, 2, 3, 4, 8 and 16 ranks. All 36 runs match the original's full output, including the `-r` hash and `-v` validation (excluding timing lines).\n- **Speed:** n=3000, threshold 1.5. The original takes 292 s. The new code takes 2668 ms on 1 rank, then 1346, 710, 355 and 207 ms on 2, 4, 8 and 16 ranks, about 13× at 16 ranks. The 1-rank gain comes from the algorithm change below; the rest comes from MPI.\n- **Build:** clean CMake build with no warnings.\n\n**What changed**\n- **MPI parallelization:** each round, seed candidates are split cyclically across ranks. Each rank finds its best local seed, and an `MPI_Allreduce` with `MPI_MAXLOC` picks the global best. `MPI_MAXLOC` returns the lowest seed on ties, which matches the original's first-wins scan. Every rank keeps the same clustering state, so the data is generated locally and only one 8-byte reduction runs per cluster.\n- **Faster candidate growth:** the original recomputed each candidate's distance to all members at every step. The new code keeps a running max-distance per candidate and drops candidates once they reach the threshold, since that distance only grows. Candidate order is preserved, so ties resolve identically.\n- **Output and exit codes:** only rank 0 prints, and the validation result is broadcast so all ranks exit with the same status. The `-h`, bad-option and invalid-parameter paths match the original. Under `mpirun`, a nonzero exit also prints Open MPI's \"job terminated\" banner, which is standard behavior.\n- **CMake:** `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and link `MPI::MPI_CXX`. MPI is required, not optional.\n\n**Pre-existing issue, left as is**\n`generateSyntheticData` never terminates for N ≤ 30, because `int(frand() * N/30.0)` is always 0 there. The original hangs on these inputs too. I preserved this behavior, since fixing it would change the data generated. I can fix it separately if you want."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":859,"cache_read_input_tokens":60413,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":859},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"e21d43ac-3873-4b7b-bf00-0bc065727661","uuid":"474978d2-fd41-43ec-a46f-2790799e7964","timestamp":"2026-10-14T07:52:48.939Z","request_id":"req_011Cg1mSw1bCDxyVWt2ZcNQB"}
